extracted text: The paper describes AA7475-T761 and AA2219-O aluminum alloys. AA7475 has an improved combination of strength and fracture toughness among high strength aerospace grade aluminium alloys. AA2219 alloy could be used for cryogenic tanks in space crafts. Figure 1 shows the microstructure of base materials where AA7475 alloy consists of elongated grains with randomly distributed precipitates whereas the microstructure of AA2219-O alloy consists of randomly oriented grains with less number of precipitates.
